author: Infinity_God
body:
• Your minecraft username (most recent name if changed) it was minecraftguy2304 now it is Infinity_God which is my most recent name
  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned  for aimbot and antiKB
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server. it has been about 1&half years since i got band, and i have not hacked since i have learned my lesson trust me 

There are some things to think about before making an appeal.
  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false? no it was not sadly 
  • Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false? no sorry
  • Have I waited long enough to be un-banned? ummmm? 1&half years its your guess not mine 
  • Have I been caught ban evading? No, i dont think so at least 
  • Have I appealed a ban before? no i have not i have been waiting my time like i was in jail to the point u guys might forget how bad i was :(
  • i hope u accept this and i can play avicus 1 last time! :)
